description: Hand-labeled consensus gold benchmark of 25 promises for independent agreement testing

gold_promises.rationale: Crisis triage center opened at 822 Geary on April 28, 2025.
1,500 new shelter beds in first 6 months not delivered.
Runway 28L reconstruction opened on schedule before Memorial Day.
Harvey Milk Terminal 1 final boarding area completed.
JFK Promenade made permanently car-free by Board of Supervisors vote.
Inaugural season tickets sold out at Chase Center.
Warriors won NBA championship within 5 years of Chase Center plan.
Store opened at 1185 Market St on March 10, 2022 (later shuttered in 2023).
Dead & Company resumed touring after Farewell Tour pledge.
Multi-year sustainable aviation fuel transition ongoing through 2030.
Nonstop flights between SFO and Monterrey commenced in 2024.
Executive directive declaring fentanyl emergency signed on day one.
Autonomous robotaxi rides launched for San Francisco waitlist.
Commercial 24/7 robotaxi operations opened citywide without waitlist.
Central Subway missed December 2018 completion date.
Phase 1 affordable housing open; later phases under construction.
82,000 housing element cycle runs through 2031.

gold_promises.entity: City and County of San Francisco
gold_promises.rationale: Vision Zero 10-year goal of zero traffic fatalities missed by 2024.
Downtown revitalisation grant target fell short of committed tenant activations.
Embarcadero Navigation Center delivered by end of 2019.
Hiring 425 new police officers multi-year target currently underway.
Mandatory tenant right to counsel implementation missed statutory timeline.
Permitted e-scooter fleet operation authorized and maintained.
Prop I revenue failed to deliver projected affordable housing acquisition.
Housing Trust Fund established and funded as promised.
